newsitem.title: USA: SC Bancorp weighs strategic alternatives.
newsitem.headline: SC Bancorp weighs strategic alternatives.

text.p: SC Bancorp said on Monday its board of directors was considering strategic alternatives for the institution, which is the holding company for Southern California Bank.
Company officials were not available for further comment.
SC Bancorp also said its board adopted an amendment to set a record date for consent solicitations.

Under the adopted bylaw, shareholders seeking to take action by written consent are required to request the board establish a record date for determining the shareholders entitled to execute such consents.
